newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLAR SAYS EQUITY RATIO TO RISE TO 34 PCT.
newsitem.headline: POLAR SAYS EQUITY RATIO TO RISE TO 34 PCT.

text.p: Finnish construction group Polar-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Wednesday the recent increase in its share capital would raise its equity to assets ratio to 34 percent from 15.9 percent at the end of August.
"The actions taken have strengthened Polar-Yhtyma's financial position significantly," Polar said.
Polar said a meeting of its board of directors had approved the subscriptions of its new shares, convertible and other bonds. The new capital programme had been announced in October.
It said new instruments worth a total of 1.48 billion markka had been issued, and that share capital rose to 1.16 billion markka from 529.8 million markka at the end of August.
Polar said that after the share issue, its biggest shareholders were Cervuctum Oy with 34.5 percent, and forestry group UPM-Kymmene with 7.6 percent of the shares.
Cervuctum is owned by engineering group Metra Oy Ab, UPM-Kymmene, construction material and cargo handling equipment maker Partek Oy Ab and co-operative retailer SOK.
